name: OlympicArena
description: OlympicArena is a benchmark comprising 11,163 bilingual problems across text-only and multimodal formats, covering seven disciplines and 62 international Olympic competitions. It evaluates AI cognitive reasoning abilities in complex, interdisciplinary scientific challenges with detailed process-level and modality-specific analyses.
reputation: A new, ambitious benchmark that has attracted interest for its broad Olympic-style reasoning coverage, but it is still early in community adoption.
notes: Includes a benchmark dataset, annotation platform, evaluation tool, and leaderboard with automatic submission.
